We’re all very excited that everyone can now get Wobbly with their friends no matter what they’re playing on!

Welcome to the final Space Update Preview! We’re super excited for you to get your hands on the update next month. But in the meantime these previews will give you a sneak peek at some of what’s coming in the v1.0 Space Update! This preview is all about exploring space.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Note: All of this content is still in active development and so isn’t final and could change!

Now you know how to survive in Space you may be wondering what you can do up here! Well, while looking for aliens, uncovering lost space artifacts and exploring the unknown might sound exciting… it might be better to start off with something a little easier. Like exploring the Space Station!

The Space Station is the central hub for all your Space adventures. It has plenty of opportunities for jobs as well as places to chill out and relax, so make yourself at home. Or even make it your home and buy a house there too!
Another popular activity is to do a bit of shopping at the Space Mall, but for that you’ll need some Space Credits.
So you want to buy some new Space gear? Well your Wobbly Dollars won’t get you anywhere in Space. You’ll need to get yourself some Space Credits, this is the only currency accepted in Space stores.
The only way to get Space Credits is to go out there and get yourself a Space Job. Then you’ll be buying that shiny helmet in no time!

When you’re ready to travel beyond the station, Space still has loads to offer. Whether you take a trip to the Space Diner or Mining Asteroid, there are plenty of things to do. You might even explore somewhere no Space Wobbly has ever been before! Just jump in your spaceship and see where it takes you.
Space is a big place, so be careful out there. You never know what you might find…
Don’t forget we’ve got merch!
We have more stuff coming to the store very soon so keep an eye out for that!

So you’ve finally made it into Space, and you’re wondering how you’re going to survive up here? Well the Wobbly Space Programme has been busy creating a whole new world for you.
They’ve set up their base inside an asteroid field, which is great for landing and building on. But not that safe during an asteroid storm…
While out exploring space make sure you take a Space Helmet with you. Helmets are a new type of clothing in Wobbly Life, they are auto equipped every time you enter a low gravity area.
You can swap out which helmet you want to use using the helmet machines. They can also be equipped as hats, useful if you like them so much you want to wear them indoors.

Gravity can be weird in Space, so you’ll need to be careful out there. Luckily Wobbly’s have developed small gravity fields and built them into the platforms in Space so you don’t float off. How convenient!

Spaceships are the best way to get around in Space. You’ll come across lots of different types. Some are small and fast while others are large and slow but can carry cargo. Many of them also have boosts for getting around faster.
Try them all out to find your favourite way to blast off!
Don’t forget we’ve got merch!
We have more stuff coming to the store very soon so keep an eye out for that!

Welcome to the v1.0 Space Update!
Space is here! We’ve been working on it for a long time now and we want to thank you all for waiting. We are so excited that you all get to finally jump in.

This update marks our exit from Early Access which is a big moment for the whole team, and we’ve put all our efforts into making this the biggest update yet! It’s been an amazing journey over the past five years. Thank you for all your support, we really couldn’t have done it without you.
So when you’re ready, get over to the Wobbly Space Centre and start your Space Wobbly journey!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ The Wobbly Space Centre

Once you’ve blasted off into space you'll find a whole new open world to explore. Take a shopping trip to the Space Mall, help serve customers at the Space Diner or take a trip down the Asteroid Mines. There are loads of new places to discover!

You’ll experience very low gravity when out in space, so take care when travelling around. Fortunately platforms around Space have small gravity generators built into them to stop Wobbly’s floating away, so stick near these and you’ll be just fine!
So you’ve seen something in Space you want to buy. Well then, you’ll be needing some Space Credits! Lucky for you there are loads of new jobs that can earn you credits.
Think you’re a crack shot, then join the Asteroid Defence Unit and help protect the Space Station. Or maybe you’re great with a pick axe? Well, head down to the Asteroid Mine!
If you’re feeling brave the Space Rescue Job has you rescuing stranded spaceships in outer space. But beware as the layout of these spaceships is different every time, so be careful not to get lost!
There are plenty of ways to make money out in Space!

With all this space to travel through, you’re going to need to get yourself a spaceship! There are spaceships of all shapes and sizes available. Some are fast and agile, while others are slower but can carry cargo. So make sure you take the right one for the job!
You can also buy your own personal spaceship and customise it at the Space Garage just like in Wobbly Island.
Looking for something to do? Even in space Wobby’s still need your help!
We have added loads of new missions, so keep your eyes open as they are everywhere.

Fancy being a detective but in Space, head up the escalators in the Mall and visit Detective Biff, he is always looking for assistance. Or if you like gardening, how about you take Professor Peats space gardening classes on the Asteroid Mine. If you want some more dangerous work there’s always the Space Cadets too.
There are Wobbly’s to help all over the place!
A mysterious robot calling themself “The Collector” is setting up a new museum in Space and is looking for Space Artifacts... Maybe you could help? I’m sure The Collector would be super grateful.
As you venture into Space, make sure you keep your eyes peeled for anything unusual. You never know who… or what you might find out there.
Also look out for Space Presents. They’ve suddenly appeared all over the sector, I wonder if you can find them all!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ More secrets to uncover

Tired of your old Wobbly Island clothes? Then visit the Space Mall and give yourself that new spacey look! Then pop over to the Space Pet Shop and get a new pet to bring along with you on your adventures.
A new item of clothing introduced in Space is the Space Helmet. You’ll need a helmet to travel in low gravity, so make sure you buy one that suits your style!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Over 150 new items of clothing + new Space Pets

The water in Wobbly Life just got a whole lot cooler. V1.0 adds new beautiful reflections to all major areas of water. There is a performance hit when using them though, so they can be disabled in the graphics settings if needed.
There are many other small improvements in this update too. Here are a few of the important ones -
We’ve improved the latency online quite significantly so your online sessions just got a bit more snappy.
We’ve also added the ability to sell your house while trying to buy a new one, removing the need to travel to the old house to sell it first.
Finally we have added a much requested feature. The option to disable the player icons in multiplayer. You can find this in the Settings section of the Options Menu.

Thank you for joining us for early access, it’s been a real pleasure for us working on this game. It’s been a real passion project for all of us and we’re so glad that so many of you got to play and enjoy it!

items.text: Hello Wobblies,
Welcome to the Big Screen update!
It’s that time of year, snow is falling and Wobbly Island is looking festive. We’re huddled inside in the warmth still working hard on v1.0 and are so excited for you to see it next year!

But in the meantime this update brings a few festive treats for you to enjoy, including a revamped Temple, more NPCs, more performance updates, more secrets and something special in the city for you all to enjoy. We hope you all enjoy it, happy holidays!
Have you ever seen a movie poster in Wobbly Life and wished that it was real? Well your wish has now come true!

The cinema in the city has had a revamp with a new selection of movies for you to watch. There’s action, adventure, romance and comedy on offer. So grab some popcorn, take a seat and enjoy a whole new world of Wobbly cinema!
The jungle temple was one of the first major levels we added to the game. And we thought it was time it had some love. So the whole level has had a complete makeover with new art, effects and sounds.
So if you’re in a mood for adventure it’s definitely worth a visit! You never know what secrets you could uncover…

The elves and snowman are back bringing festive cheer to Wobbly Island. So if you haven’t got their outfits yet, now is your chance. And even if you have, why not knock down a few snowmen anyway because hey, it’s fun!

Fancy yourself a racing driver? Well now here’s your chance to prove yourself. Take a visit to the Wobbly Racetrack in our new Sandbox map. Unleash chaos on the racetrack with the new Formula Wobbly car or mix it up with any vehicle you like!

We’ve added dozens of new NPCs to Wobbly Island breathing more life into the world. Lots of them have fun new animations and dialog. So if you drive past them on your travels why not see what they’re up to.

There are lots of performance improvements in this update, especially for the jungle areas. We’ve streamlined a lot of the backend systems for rendering and animation which should help performance especially on lower end machines.

We’ve also made lots of other small improvements to the game. Grass has had some rendering improvements so that it no longer uses a 2D billboard. Snow now leaves small splodges on the ground. Also minimap icons that are near you will now fade when you are too far above or below their location. There are also new video options for contrast and brightness.

As you Wobblies know, it is very important for our team to make sure we keep improving the quality of the Wobbly experience for you. On top of the new content listed above, we have also introduced many more improvements and bug fixes to the game; please find our detailed list below:
Cinema makeover with real wobbly movies to watch!

Find Candy Canes and deliver them to the elves for rewards, and smash snowmen to see what prizes are inside!
Wobbly island is now coated in snow and everyone has their decorations up! Some Wobblies will now be seen wearing their holiday clothes.
New Race Track Sandbox Map. Race your friends in the Formula Wobbly race car unique to this map or test your driving skills in any vehicle available in the sandbox menu!

Hello Wobblies,
Welcome to the Curious Collectors update!

In this latest update, we’re introducing you to a mysterious new resident of Wobbly Island. We can’t wait for you and your friends to explore his arcane secrets and prepare your Museum for opening day!
The team’s been hard at work crafting this fun new experience for you all, and we can’t thank you enough for all the feedback and support you give us in growing Wobbly Life.

This is a smaller content update than some of the previous ones, as we have been busy working on a big update for v1.0 alongside developing v0.9.5. We can’t wait for you to see what’s in store for v1.0. But we ask for your patience while we make it as awesome as we can, meanwhile we hope you enjoy creating some magical chaos in v0.9.5!

Have you ever struggled to find all the presents in the game? Then you’re in luck, the Wizard is coming to Wobbly Island! In the Curious Collectors update you’ll find this magical character. The Wizard will help you locate missing presents. Keep your eyes peeled for a tent with a wagon outside…
If you were wondering who’s been leaving those presents all over Wobbly Island, wonder no more!

Having sprinkled these gifts all over the world, the Wizard will now help you track down any missing presents from your collection - for a small fee, that is. Once you’ve ponied up, simply peer into his crystal ball to see the location of a missing present and add it to your map.
Outside his tent, the Wizard will sell you magical items, potions and spells. Get out there in Wobbly Island, earn some cash, and go on a magical spending spree!
The Wizard Collection has been added to the Museum. Can you uncover the secrets of the mysterious Wizard and find all his artifacts?

items.text: Hello all Wobblies,
Welcome to the v0.9.4 Update!

In this Wobbly update, discover what’s below the surface of Wobbly Island and take a deep dive into the Sewers! We hope you and your friends enjoy playing and discovering all the new secrets hidden in the Sewers, as much as we've loved making it!

Over the past months, our team has been working hard to make our game accessible in 11 new languages. We’re excited to be launching localization with this update and are giving a warm welcome to all new non-English speaking Wobblies joining us in our adventure!
We’d like to thank each and everyone of our players; your wobbly feedback, dedication, videos, comments, engagement is inspiring us everyday to grow our game and improve it. Thank you!
Have you ever wondered what’s going on below your dear Wobbly Island? It’s time to find out!

We’re so excited to introduce a new main mission to Wobbly Life: “Deep in the Sewers”, which will introduce a whole new sewers system for you to explore, get lost, solve puzzles, and get lost in again! The Sewers is an exciting place of mysteries to be discovered, secrets to unravel and (familiar?) monsters lurking…

Our team has been working hard on implementing the localization update over the past few months, and we’re proud to make our Wobbly world more accessible with the release of the game today on all platforms in 11 new languages: French, German, Spanish, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese.

We’ve included a few surprises and secrets to uncover for you in this new update. You can do a favour for your old monster friend Louie: nothing tastes as good as his new delicious (but toxic) recipe. I hear rocket engineers are working in the jungle… Time to wander around, see if you can bump into some secret rocket science! All around Wobbly Island, new manholes are waiting for a Wobbly crazy enough to jump into them and explore. Outside or inside the Sewers, expect the unexpected!

We have added 9 new unlockable outfits and clothes, including 5 outfits inspired by the most creative minds in our community! Wear the Bunny Pyjamas to your next pyjama party, turn into a Sewer Monster for Halloween, feel magical with the Whimsical Elf outfit, play some music in the Old Timey Fancy Pants Bard and sky is the limit with the Rocket Outfit! Congratulations and thank you again to all the winners. We hope you will all enjoy the search and adventure to find them!

For all of you Wobblies suffering from owning too many clothes, we hear you and have decided to make your life a little easier... Clothes in the wardrobe will now display in the order of clothes you have unlocked so you can easily find the latest fancy pants you’ve unlocked! And if you’re still taking too long to choose the perfect outfit for the day, we have also added a random button in the wardrobe: roll the dice and let fate decide how good you’re going to look!

Once again, the Wobbly Museum needs your detective expertise and help! Will you find the four new missing artifacts?

items.text: Hello all Wobblies!
Welcome to the v0.9.0 Update!
Arcade Mode is here. You’ve all seen the button on the menu, and now you can play it!

This update is a bit different to our normal updates, it has sort of been like creating a brand new game. We’re really excited for you all to play it with your friends and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!
We’re also super excited to be releasing the first version of our mod tools. We can’t wait to see what people can create with them!

Arcade is the main feature of this update. It has been in the works for a very long time. Arcade isn’t just one game mode, Arcade has 4 official modes for you to play: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each of these modes also has customizable settings for you to play around with!

Trash Zone is an asymmetric party game where one player (the Trasher) will attempt to knock the other players (the Trash) into a trash compactor to knock them out. They will do this by throwing objects down into the ‘Trash Zone’, launching them at the other players. The Trash players have to dodge these objects until the timer runs out.

If the Trasher knocks all the players out, then they win. But if any of the Trash players survive until the end of the timer, then they win. Any players who get pushed into the trash compactor spawn back in and can help the Trasher take out the remaining players.
We hope this gamemode will be a new experience for Wobbly Life players and a load of fun to play with friends.
To find out more about Trash Zone read our Arcade Development Preview #1.
Hide and Seek is a mode where one player is the “Seeker”, and the rest of the players are the “Hiders”.
When the game starts the Hiders have a short time to go find somewhere to hide. The Seeker stays behind a locked door while they go and hide.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Left - A Seeker in the locked room. Right - A Hider hiding in a box
Once the hiding timer reaches zero the door unlocks and the Seeker is released to go find the Hiders.

To catch a Hider the Seeker needs to grab them, and if the Seeker catches all the Hiders before the timer runs out then the Seeker wins. But if any Hiders manage to evade the Seeker until the timer runs out then they win.
When a Hider is caught, they spectate until the end of the game.
Hide and Seek has 4 maps: Quarry, Office, Village and Jungle.
To find out more about Hide & Seek read our Arcade Development Preview #2.
Wobble Run is a race through colorful obstacle courses. Players will need to jump, dodge, grab and wobble their way to victory. The first Wobbly over the finish line wins!
Wobble Run courses are made up of different obstacles each with their own challenges. Compete against your friends to see who can get the best time!
Wobble Run has 10 courses for you to compete in. Below are some screenshots of our favorites!
The courses vary in difficulty and each one will have unique challenges. You can also adjust timers, weather and enable/disable checkpoints in the settings.
To find out more about Wobble Run read our Arcade Development Preview #3.

Sandbox mode is the physics playground you always wanted. Spawn Objects & Vehicles using the Sandbox Menu and let your imagination run wild. Want to know what would happen if you blew up 50 TNT’s inside a bouncy castle? Well now you can find out!
Sandbox has 4 maps for you to play around with: Empty, Large Bedroom, City & Stadium. The Sandbox menu also features settings to alter player speed and jump strength, as well as a noclip mode.
The other side of the Arcade mode are Mods. This is the first beta version of our mods tools. These are only available to Steam users and use the Steam Workshop.

Mods allow you to create your own experiences using our mod tools via the Unity game engine - this could be your own gamemode or a custom world for you to mess around with the physics… it’s completely up to you!
To create a mod you use the Wobbly Life Mod SDK. You can find documentation for it here. We plan to add more functionality to the SDK and update the documentation in the future.

Mod demo versions of the Trash Zone and Quarry Hide and Seek maps can be found here for reference. The mod SDK allows modders to create their own sandbox maps too! Please note that creating your own custom game modes will require some coding experience.
We hope the modders out there will get stuck in and make amazing Wobbly Life content for all you PC players to enjoy!
We’ve added loads of new emotes to the emote wheel. The wheel is now divided into 4 sections each with 4 to 6 emotes in it. We hope you all enjoy these new emotes, we’ve had great fun making them!

The Main Menu has had a complete redesign and is now set on Granny’s street in the main game world. The redesign should make it easier to start and find game sessions in the two different game types; World and Arcade.
This update includes some massive improvements to physics and rendering performance. Almost all users should get a boost to FPS regardless of platform.

We’ve also added a “Chunk Distance (host only)” option in the settings for PC users. This controls the distance objects will load/unload. Note that this setting is server wide and only the hosts setting has any effect. Lowering this setting can give a big boost to performance at the cost of render distance and despawning objects.
All console versions now have bloom on certain lights. This means those lights will now glow.
We’ve also added ambient occlusion to all console versions which improves shading and graphical depth for the whole game.

For the PC version of Wobbly Life we have added a backup system, which puts the last 20 saves into a directory in case you delete/corrupt the save file.
The backups are located here (replace USERNAME with your computer user name) -
>> C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\RubberBandGames\Wobbly Life\Save
You should find a folder with a bunch of numbers and _backup, the bunch of numbers is your steam id.

Once you find the folder and want to restore your game, all you need to do is make sure the game is closed, extract the backup you want to restore from its zip file, then copy all the contents inside the backup and put them inside your save folder which will be located here -
>> C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\RubberBandGames\Wobbly Life\Save
(It will be the folder with a bunch of numbers - not the one with _backup)

We hope this helps people who lose their save files. We have made a bunch of adjustments in this update to try to ensure that this doesn’t happen, but without knowing exactly what causes the save issues we have introduced this system as well.
We do plan to go into more detail soon in the Steam discussions about restoring backup saves.

Welcome to v0.6.5 The Treasure Hunt Update!
Dig up some treasure or help uncover Wobbly Islands lost history by filling in exhibitions at the Museum, there’s lots to find buried around the Island!
If you look carefully around the island you will find 3 different locations with treasure hunting fanatics who can sell you a treasure map.
There are 3 different difficulties of treasure hunts; Easy, Medium and Hard. The harder the hunt the better chance of rewards.
Once you buy a map you will notice a red circle on the main map,
(Press M to open the map or Up on the D-Pad on controller) Take a metal detector and explore the area within the red circle.

While holding a metal detector it will beep when you are close to buried treasure and speed up the closer you are. When you find where it’s buried press 2 (Left on D-Pad on controller) to dig it up. You might find some treasure. Take any coins, ingots and goblets back to the treasure shops to cash them in.
There is also a chance you could dig up an artifact!
A new addition to Wobbly Island is the Museum! You can find it on the edge of the city next to the power plant.

The Museum has lots of relics from wobbly history, have a look around and learn about the rich past of Wobbly Island. However some collections are missing, you can help fill in the Museums missing collections by bringing any artifacts you may find on your treasure hunting travels.
You can identify an artifact by its distinctive yellow glow. Bring enough artifacts to the Museum and you might get a reward.
There are also some treasure spots dotted around the island outside of the treasure maps, so buy a metal detector from a treasure shop and get searching!
Note: The Museum isn’t finished, we plan to add more collections as we go towards full release

Hello all Wobblies!
Just want to say a massive thank you for all the support, this is our biggest update yet!
This update is also special as we are coming up to the 1 year anniversary of Wobbly Life entering early access!
Thank you so much to everyone who has continued to support us so far, we hope you will join us for the rest of our journey!

Quick note before talking about v0.6.0, we've decided to post pone full release (i.e Exiting Early Access) for another year, mainly because of the support which Wobbly Life has been given, in short, we want to keep making Wobbly Life the best it can be. What does this mean to you Wobblies out there, it means more content!
We have revamped a lot of the core systems in Wobbly Life to give a better quality of life as well as adding a huge amount of new content!
Something strange is happening in the mountain.
First of all there is a big change to the save system. You are now able to have multiple world saves and character saves.

The world save contains all the progress within your world such as missions and certain statistics, this can be anything from Buying your first house and making Granny proud to doing the tutorial or completing the Intro cutscene, this is all shared across each character.

Each World save also contains 4 character saves within it, this means if you play splitscreen a lot you don’t have to always have a second controller plugged in if you only wanted to play the second character!
The character save slot keeps track of your individual data such as money, clothes, vehicles and houses.
Don't worry your old save will be converted to the new system and there will be a backup created in
Path: %AppData%\\LocalLow\\RubberBandGames\\Wobbly Life\\Save\\STEAMID\\GameSaves\\Backup_Old
We have also made some big changes to the way wardrobes and clothes shops work!
Clothes shops now each have their own unique clothes catalogue with some items only showing in certain shops.

In addition to this we have revamped the UI of both the Shops and Wardrobe to a much more user friendly design. Icons represent all the clothes available allowing players to easily navigate to what they want.
The island is more lively than ever with lots of new jobs!
Help keep the forest tidy as a lumberjack, crack the code as a scientist or help prevent disaster as a firefighter, you may even find yourself flying a jet.
Check out the WobblyTV Studios and see if you have what it takes to rise to the top in the Wonderful Wobbly Quiz!
There's lots of new stuff to see in this update.
Ever wondered whether that wobbly speeding by was delivering a pizza or losing a street race?
Now you can know, while on a job your minimap icon will show others what job it is you are doing.
The community spoke, we listened. I introduce vertical split screen!
You can now find in the game options menu an option for vertical split screen. Turn this on to play side by side.
We recently ran a competition for our community to design their own vehicles!
We were amazed by the creativity and talent within our community.
The winners were recently announced and are now all in the game.
Can you find them all?

items.text: Hi Everyone,
Appreciate the love and support for Wobbly Life.
This update is a tad different to most of our regular updates but does contain some hidden secrets for all you Wobblies out there.

One thing to note, when you launch up Wobbly Life, it will repeat the first intro - This is because we have completely redesigned our mission system so that we can add cutscenes and different missions whenever necessary, this wasn't that possible with the previous system. At the moment we haven't even touched the surface with the missions system, so hopefully in the future updates more of that will come.
The community has requested more emotes for a while now and we are excited to show you our new emote wheel!
Another feature we've added is the Prop Shop.

We created Prop Shops to bring more of a Sandbox feel to the game. Prop Shops are located all over Wobbly Island, they allow you to purchase various props within the world you are playing in, these are great for just having a good laugh or even role playing with. However these props do not stay around and currently there is no limit to how many you can purchase, this is something we are going to experiment with.
[Current Props Shops Available]
Generic Food Shop
Fruit and Veg Shop
Coffee Shop/Cake Shop
Fast Food Shop
Meat Shop
Few more
We plan to add more various and crazy shops in the future, but for now we want to experiment with these.
Another thing we've added is for all you new Wobblies out there is a Tutorial.

The tutorial goes over the basic controls of Wobbly Life and how to get your first job to make granny proud. The the Jelly job is part of the tutorial and is also now a repeatable job within Wobbly Island,
We hope that the tutorial system helps new players feel at home within Wobbly Life
